about.title: About Us
about.lead: Bishop's Math Club (BMC) — a group of people who love math: competitions, training, and fun. We attend annual tournaments and run our own activities. Here's the year-by-year chronicle.
about.tournamentsHint: Annual tournaments, ordered by school year — tap a card for details and official links.
about.programsHint: Activities organized by BMC — also ordered by school year.

resources.title: Math Resources
resources.hint: Pick the right tool, save ten years. A permanent shelf + weekly picks.
resources.featuredHint: Rotates every week — watch and move on.

note.aoPS: The AMC/AIME prep mecca — past problems, forums, courses
note.maa: Official US math competitions — AMC 8/10/12 registration, dates, past papers
note.bprp: Step-by-step math from high school to university — watch and learn the thinking
note.overleaf: Official LaTeX tutorials — the typesetting basics for math homework and notes
note.b3b1b: The gold standard of visual math — every animation is a lesson
note.numberphile: Chat with mathematicians — one concept, one story
note.mathworld: The math encyclopedia — authoritative definitions, formulas, properties
note.oeis: Integer sequence database — look it up, see it graphed
note.curves: Famous curves gallery — from circles to butterfly curves, math's beauty in one place
note.primes: Prime glossary — Sophie Germain primes, twin primes and more
note.erdos: Erdős's open problem bank — unsolved problems worldwide, see how mathematicians think
note.arxiv: Preprint library — the first stop for fresh math research
note.euler: Solve math with code — one problem, one algorithm
note.desmos: Graphing calculator — plot functions, explore parameters with sliders, free and powerful
note.geogebra: Interactive geometry — drag points, lines and planes to see properties instantly
note.mactutor: 3200+ mathematician biographies and math history articles — the people behind the math
note.quanta: Top-tier math/science news and deep reads — follow the research front line
note.stackexchange: Math Q&A community — someone has usually already asked what you don't get
note.fractal: Imaginary bases × Gaussian integers — an entire fractal world
note.extendSum: Lines That Connect — extend summation functions to every number
note.count: How many ways to count? One question, a whole branch of math
note.rps: Rock-paper-scissors can be math too — game theory and probability
note.rhythm: Rhythm × circle — feel math's cycles through music
note.grayCuber: The group theory under the Rubik's cube — twist your way into math
